messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: Streaming endpoint /v1/stream/generate (us-west-2) p99 latency > 5s for the last 5m. Paging on-call: @oncall-eng. Runbook: <https://redwood.ops/runbooks/stream-tail-latency>.

oncall-eng: I’m on it, ack'ing. Starting triage — pulling recent deploys and perf metrics.

alice.nguyen: saw the spike correlate with the precision-profile rollout at 2026-03-15T18:07:02Z — that was the int8 calibration profile `int8-low-mem-v2`.

mateo.rodriguez: can confirm. Deploy event: ```
# deploy log
redwood deploy profile --model llama-14b --profile int8-low-mem-v2 --env us-west-2 --who=alice.nguyen
timestamp: 2026-03-15T18:07:02Z
```

priya.k: metrics I’m watching: p95 jumped from 180ms -> 800ms, p99 from 420ms -> 5.2s. Streaming stalls reported by the proxy: a lot of `KVCache miss` followed by long `dequantize_loop` stalls.

ops-bot: Recent logs (excerpt): ```
[18:09:12] stream-worker-23 WARN dequantize_loop: kv_miss=0.62 stall_ms=340
[18:09:13] stream-worker-19 ERROR streaming: stall_detected reason=kv_cache_eviction
[18:09:14] router INFO fallthrough_count=27 route=fallback-fp32
```

sre-lead: > Is this the calibration process that runs post-profile-apply? Could overflow the KV cache or change memory layout triggering slow paths.

alice.nguyen: yes — int8-low-mem-v2 enabled a new calibration hook that rewrites KV layout for long-context streaming. It looked stable in canary but scale difference exposed a pathological case.

oncall-eng: customer-impact check: @customer-success-bot, any downstream reports?

customer-success-bot: two customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: betaapps) opened support tickets complaining about repeated reconnects and slow streaming. Both flagged after 18:10 UTC. No data exfiltration, impact = degraded streaming UX.

mateo.rodriguez: immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback precision profile to previous `int8-baseline` 2) route streaming traffic to fp16/fp32 variant 3) disable calibration hook globally. Rollback is fastest.

priya.k: rollback command ready, but it will affect other models using same profile. If we route just streaming we can avoid full rollback: ```
redwood routes create --from /v1/stream/generate --to model/llama-14b@fp16 --policy immediate
```

sre-lead: I prefer rollback for speed and simplicity. Can we test a partial route for a region first?

oncall-eng: performing a targeted route to fp16 for us-west-2 streaming traffic now — will monitor.

ops-bot: Executing: `redwood routes update --region us-west-2 --route /v1/stream/generate --target fp16` 

incident-bot: Note: changing route for live traffic — will hit per-token billing differences. Confirmed by billing-check service.

alice.nguyen: after route flip at 18:13:40 UTC p99 dropped to 620ms within 90s — significant improvement. Graph snapshots: <https://grafana.redwood/s/streams/d-snapshot-240555>.

priya.k: streaming stalls stopped, KV miss rate down to normal, dequantize stalls absent in worker logs.

customer-success-bot: replied to affected customers: we applied a mitigation and are monitoring; next update in 30m. :heart:

mateo.rodriguez: plan for next steps: 1) revert the `int8-low-mem-v2` rollout fully from production, 2) run extended canary with larger context sequences and KV-eviction stress, 3) add calibration preflight checks to catch layout regressions.

alice.nguyen: creating a revert PR now and will trigger a safe rollback: ```
# revert
redwood deploy profile --model llama-14b --profile int8-baseline --env us-west-2 --reason "rollback calibration fallout"
```

noncall-eng: rolling back in 2m. Notifying infra for assistance with cache warmups.

ops-bot: rollback completed at 18:21:05 UTC. Post-rollback metrics: p95=170ms, p99=390ms, error-rate unchanged.

priya.k: verifying streaming continuity: synthetic stream sessions show stable chunk throughput, no reconnects for 10m.

sre-lead: good triage. Action items logged: postmortem, adjust canary test suite to include KV cache eviction scenarios, add alert to detect rapid increase in dequantize loop stalls. Owner: alice.nguyen. ETA: 72h for postmortem draft.

alice.nguyen: I’ll own the postmortem and add extra canary load tests. Will also add gate that blocks `calibration_hook` enabling without full-context canaries.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: mitigated, routing workaround applied and rollback completed, customer impact acknowledged. Paging cleared for @oncall-eng.

customer-success-bot: added status page note: "Temporary degradation for some streaming customers while we reverted a precision profile. No data loss. Follow-up: root cause analysis in progress."

mateo.rodriguez: leaving a short-term follow-up: check replications that use async streaming (EU region) — ensure they didn’t inherit the profile unintentionally.

noncall-eng: ack. Posting handoff: oncall->sre-lead for postmortem and timeline.

sre-lead: thanks all — nice fast coordination. Next steps: postmortem, TTL for profile rollouts, better telemetry on calibration hooks. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Timeline summary (automated): 
- 18:07:02 UTC profile rollout `int8-low-mem-v2`
- 18:09 UTC p99 starts climbing, streaming stalls observed
- 18:13:40 UTC targeted route to fp16 applied (mitigation)
- 18:21:05 UTC full rollback to `int8-baseline` completed (fix)

(End of thread)
